item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01650","case1_error":"Omits the $20 flat reservation fee from the total deposit.","case2_error":"Omits the $150 fixed rental fee from the total spending.","reason":"Both correctly calculate variable charges but omit the required fixed fee when forming the total.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01651","case1_error":"Models 12 feet higher as adding 12 to burial depth instead of subtracting it.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 12 + 6 - 1 + 5 - 2 as 18 instead of 20.","reason":"The first writes an incorrect depth relation; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01652","case1_error":"Calculates fuel cost by multiplying miles directly by dollars per gallon, omitting conversion through 10 miles per gallon.","case2_error":"Reports only outbound gas costs, omitting tolls and all return-trip costs.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect fuel-cost relation; the second leaves required expense components and return travel out of the total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01653","case1_error":"Uses the old $5000 monthly salary for the new company's 41 months, ignoring the 20% raise.","case2_error":"Divides revenue remaining after wages by employee count instead of dividing the calculated wage budget.","reason":"The first omits a required salary adjustment; the second selects the wrong quantity for calculating each employee's wage.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01654","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan's quarter-share and omits Chris's withdrawal.","case2_error":"Equates twice the remaining marbles to 5 rather than current age plus 5, then unjustifiably identifies age with 100.","reason":"The first omits one person's required withdrawal; the second misrepresents the age relation and makes an unsupported identification of age.","judgment":"different"}]}
